{{Youmay|the prison named Lusankya|the Star Dreadnought ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'', in which the prison was housed}}
'''Lusankya''' was [[Ysanne Isard]]'s private [[Prison/Legends|prison]], housed within the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] [[Lusankya/Legends|of the same name]], which itself was buried within the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[City/Legends|cityscape]].<ref name="The Krytos Trap">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref> At the feared secret prison, Isard brainwashed captives, turning them into [[Sleeper agent/Legends|secret agents]] that she then released to be activated in the future.<ref name="Wedge's Gamble">''[[X-Wing: Wedge's Gamble]]''</ref> To confound escapees, the prison was built into the [[Star Dreadnought/Legends|Star Dreadnought]] upside down, artificial gravity reorienting decks as ceilings. As the prison interiors were clad in stone and the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] were led to believe they were within a mine, attempts to escape to the surface would only lead prisoners deeper into the Star Dreadnought, staffed by Isard's personnel.<ref name="The Krytos Trap" />

After the ''Lusankya'' was captured by the New Republic, the prison was removed and replaced with a quarantine unit that was mostly serviced by droids and could be completely isolated from the rest of the ship.  This unit was built in the event any of the Imperial remnants attempted further biological warfare on the New Republic. <ref name="Isard's Revenge">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>
